titleLine: Senior MarTech, Marketing Automation & AI Growth Lead
paragraphs: I am writing to express my interest in the [Role Title] position at [Company Name]. With over 10 years of experience building scalable CRM, marketing automation, and performance marketing systems for global businesses, I am confident I can bring immediate impact to your marketing organisation.

At IONOS, I architected enterprise marketing automation infrastructure spanning eight international brands, built an internal AI automation application that cut manual work by roughly 80%, and drove a 250% increase in customer acquisition within five months. Earlier in my career, I generated 37x ROAS at HackerEarth and $8.7M in revenue on a $95K budget at CENTA, giving me a track record of turning automation and data into measurable growth.

I am based in Karlsruhe, hold an EU Blue Card (no sponsorship required), and can start with three months' notice. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to [Company Name]'s marketing goals.
